entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Transformers such as BERT, GPT and LLaMA
Building and deploying AI apps with Flask and IBM Watson
reading.format: An online Professional Certificate made up of a 16 course series. The page lists hands-on labs, projects and a guided project in which learners create their own real-world generative AI application. It is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: This is a 16 course Professional Certificate series from IBM, delivered on Coursera, that teaches generative AI engineering. The page says learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents and chatbots, and work with large language models and natural language processing. It is listed at beginner level and the page states it takes about 6 months with no prior experience required. Completing it earns an IBM certificate that the page describes as employer-recognized.
reading.audience: The page names aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It is listed as beginner level with no prior experience required.
reading.prerequisites: Beginner level. The page states no prior experience is required.
